decisions.reason: The Power Board's compact dimensions, connector placement, mounting holes, and aspect ratio do not change the established three-board architecture.
The mechanical form-factor decision does not change battery protection, cutoff, or thermal-sensing requirements.
The source specifies USB-C and mounting-hole placement but does not change the battery connector's required NTC contact.
Board dimensions and mechanical placement do not alter the specified I2C cable length, speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
The Power Board mechanical layout decision does not affect the ESP32 clock, sleep policy, or wake sources.
The source does not change the switched 5V rail's converter, GPIO control, default state, sensor-power purpose, or operating pattern.
